title: Оборудование для автосервиса
text: Всё необходимое для рабочих постов и мастерских
prompt: Create ONE FINISHED RASTER ADVERTISEMENT, landscape 3:2, not a UI mockup. Premium Light Industrial Advertising for Russian auto workshop store Garage. Reference image is the actual product composition: red/black rolling cabinet and red floor jack; preserve recognizable products and branding, no new brand. All elements BAKED INTO THIS IMAGE: background, realistic products, Russian typography, subtitle and yellow CTA. No future HTML layers. Background very light neutral #F5F6F3, outermost edges flat uniform same color so this finished image can be extended sideways for a panoramic banner. No frame, no white photo box, no glass rectangle, no excessive ornaments. Tight readable commercial composition. Equipment large on right, title/subtitle/CTA left, balanced vertically and fill the canvas. Text exact, flawless Cyrillic, modern bold sans like Manrope. Title on 2–3 lines: «Оборудование для автосервиса». Subtitle: «Всё необходимое для рабочих постов и мастерских.» Yellow rounded CTA with black text and a small right arrow: «В каталог». No other text. At 1536px canvas width, headline approximately 100px, subtitle 74px, CTA label 76px: this master will be displayed at just 276px wide, so lettering MUST be large and simple, subtitle can wrap. Keep all content within 6% safe margins. Product fully visible, no cropped handle or wheels. Natural shadows, studio light, complete coherent graphic, no UI browser chrome, no watermark.
corrections: No trailing periods; flat yellow CTA without border, bevel or thick outline. service-paint additionally repositions cup below title.

title: Подбор автоэмали
text: Материалы и помощь с подбором цвета под задачу
